basic_profile.bio: A passionate crafter and DIY enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I've been diving deep into resin art and dice-making for the past couple of years. My other interests include gaming, especially anything related to 100 Thieves, and exploring new creative hobbies. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me the flexibility to engage with my hobbies throughout the day. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner who shares my love for tabletop RPGs. Typically online late evenings and weekends, when I'm not busy with work or gaming sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in dice-making is mostly self-taught, fueled by countless hours of YouTube tutorials, Reddit threads, and community feedback. I have a background in design, which helps me in understanding aesthetics and color combinations, crucial for resin art.
